IC.IC1: Liver Transplant Recipients have received liver transplantations for at least 6+1 months prior to enrollment

IC2.IC2.2: o acute rejection episodes within 3 months prior to the enrollment and are clinically stable

IC.IC3: Liver Transplant Recipients have been treated with twice-daily regimen of tacrolimus(TAC) plus everolimus(EVR) and TAC and EVR trough levels have stayed within targeted ranges for at least 6 weeks prior to enrollment
IC.IC4: Provide written informed consent prior to inclusion.
IC.IC5: Liver transplant recipients who are 18-65 years of age of a primary liver transplant
IC.IC6: Allograft functioning at an acceptable level as defined by the AST, ALT, Total Bilirubin levels =3 times ULN prior to enrollment.
